scripts.build: pnpm assets:build && tsc -b --pretty false && pnpm --filter @bot-avatar/studio build:web
scripts.check: pnpm check:workspace && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.assets:build: tsc -b packages/core packages/design-tokens --pretty false && node scripts/compile-assets.mjs
scripts.review:assets: pnpm assets:build && tsc -b packages/renderer-svg packages/renderer-png --pretty false && node scripts/asset-review.mjs
scripts.release:local: pnpm check && pnpm test:e2e && node scripts/package-local.mjs && node scripts/verify-local.mjs
